classification: post-hoc structural risk-budget repair after R333 parameter fragility; no parameter or weight search
discipline: Do not change TopN, defensive asset weights, lookbacks, target-vol grid or gate thresholds after seeing results.
The 1/3 equity cap is the sole intervention; it is a risk-budget policy, not a return-optimal weight.
The candidate remains post-hoc because it follows R333.
disclosure: R333 found that the R332 center passed but only 3/9 lookback/volatility variants passed, mostly because 2022 flipped sign. R334 responds with one structural rule rather than tuning the lookback: cap the equity sleeve at 1/3 of the risk budget at every monthly rebalance.

fixed_strategy.costs: 2x stock costs + 0.10% overlay main; 3x stock costs + 0.30% overlay stress
fixed_strategy.equity_risk_share_bounds: [0.2, 1/3] at every monthly rebalance; this replaces the prior [0.2,0.8] cap

gates.fresh_starts: at least 4/5 positive and every MDD >= -18%
gates.full_path: all R331/R332 performance and concentration gates with 2022 and 2023 >=0
gates.plateau: at least 7/9 overlay variants and 2/3 joint-target variants pass every gate

known_limitations: In-sample neighborhood audit; not independent out-of-sample proof.
ETF qfq and current industry snapshot limitations remain.
A lower equity cap may reduce long-run upside; the trade-off must be visible.
selection_rule: Only if the center passes every gate and the plateau thresholds are met, upgrade to candidate_for_paper_trading_review; otherwise record parameter fragility and do not promote.
